subject: S43
diagnostic: fixed-delay profile of the revised frozen-Stage-1 gradient PID model

gain_optimizer.method: exact automatic gradients with bounded L-BFGS-B

comparison_policy: use the same collocation times at or after 0.30 s for every fixed delay
